calculation: T78 model-specific sigma_DM-nucleon at v0.7 MAP
formula_source: Kahlhoefer et al., 'Direct detection portals for SIDM' (arXiv:2011.03079, cited in v0.3-prelim/code/channels_extended.py header)
verdict: At v0.7 MAP, sigma_DM-nucleon ~ 10^-117 cm^2, which is 71 orders of magnitude BELOW the LZ sensitivity (~10^-46 cm^2). The kinetic-mixing link exists physically but the project's epsilon ~ 10^-37 is so suppressed that LZ cannot bite. The 'practical orthogonality' framing is correct; the 'complete orthogonality' framing in the original T77 §0 update is physically overstated (the link is real, but the magnitude is negligible).
